notes.title: Update 1.03f
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

Please find below a list of changes:


     The "Silver Ring" can not be picked up before completing the associated puzzle.
     Fixed a bug where the mouse sensitivity would revert to default after examining an object.
     Rotatable "Pictures" now have the correct position when loading.
     General optimisation fixes.


Any further issues, please let us know in the community threads.

Thanks

Deceptive Games

notes.title: Official Release & Update 1.02f
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Well, we finally made it. Its been a long few months... Today, the game leaves Early Access. 

We would like to thank everyone who has participated in playing and testing the game. We are truly grateful with suggestions and feedback. With your help, we believe we have developed a great game that many have already enjoyed.

The final few issues and bugs have now been addressed. Change list can be found below:

a) Improved optimisation greatly so that the game now runs smoother on all machines.
b) MAC OS version has been released.
c) Fixed an issue where the painting puzzle would not work upon completion.
d) Fixed an issue where solving one of the locker puzzles, it would not open.
e) Fixed an issue where changing character would result in black bars top and bottom of the screen.
f) Fixed an issue where putting on the glasses would result in it toggling off even though glasses UI was being shown.
g) Changed spelling and grammar to reflect characters dialogue.
h) Greatly Improved shadows throughout
i) Fixed an issues where the settings were not saving correctly.
j) Fixed an occasional bug where the projector would not show anything when using.

Once more, if you encounter any issues while playing please let us know in the community threads, and please update the game to acquire the latest version of the game.

Many thanks

Deceptive Games Ltd.

notes.title: Update 0.98
notes.notes:
Hello,

This update mostly focuses on optimisation. 

The game now has a lower memory cost to run the game by roughly 1 gig. The lighting has also been improved, allowing for a smoother and quicker frame-rate whilst playing.

We will continue this process, in addition to fixing small bugs that might still persist. We are hopeful that the game will be ready for a full release later this month. 

As always, if you encounter any issues whilst playing the game, please let us know in the community threads.

Please close and re-open steam to acquire the latest update (0.98)

Thanks

Deceptive Games

notes.title: Update 0.95 - MAC OS Version Released
notes.notes:
Hello,

We are happy to announce that the MAC OS version of "The Initiate 2: The First Interviews"  is now live and playable.

We hope new persons can now enjoy this mystery puzzle game game for the first time since the windows release earlier this month.

If there are any issues encountered whilst playing this version, please do not hesitate to let us know in the community threads where we will rectifying those issues.

Hope you enjoy the game.

Thanks

Deceptive Games.

notes.title: Update 0.935
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

We have found a number of small issues that this update corrects. Please find change list below:


 Added subtitles to all telephone conversations.
 Modified one colour on the wall switch puzzle from yellow to white.
 Corrected the wording and spelling errors on the documents on the laptop.
 The height of the camera no longer change height when the player runs.
 Fixed a bug where a book on the bookshelf remained stationary upon moving, resulting in it floating in mid-air.
 The glasses overlay no longer displays upon reading a book.
 Fixed and error where the player could not save whilst wearing glasses.
 Fixed grammatical errors throughout the game.
 General lighting optimisations.


As always if anyone encounters any bugs or issues, please let us know in the community threads.

Please close steam and re-open to acquire the latest update.

Thanks

Deceptive Games :)

notes.title: Update 0.92
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Here is update number 0.92. Please find list of changes below:


 Fixed an issue where the bronze idol was reappearing upon game load.
 fixed and issue where player could clip through items in Steve's back room.
 Fixed grammar in the credits scene.
 Fixed an issue where Ben would still cough after completing the steam puzzle.
 Fixed an issue where one of the books that helps the player solve laptop riddle was in the wrong location, and therefore rendered useless.
 Fixed an issue where two lines of text shown on Ben's statue area after placing down the statues correctly.
 Removed a repeating book that was located inside the Office.
 Fixed an issue where using some wrong items on wrong puzzles would use the up item.
 Fixed an issue where the game looked blurry/fuzzy and not crisp. Was related to depth of field.


More changes to follow.

As always if any person finds an issue please report them in the community threads and we will address them asap.

Please close and re-open steam to acquire the latest update.

Thanks

Deceptive Games

notes.title: Update 0.91
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

More bugs have been fixed, Please find the change list below:

 Bread Bin text now has correct item description.

 keys can no longer be used twice on the same object which would result in cut-scenes re-playing.

As always, if any person(s) finds a bug or glitch, please let us know in the community threads.

Please close and re-open steam to acquire the latest update.

Thanks

Deceptive Games

notes.title: Update 0.9

Another week, another update. Please find the list of changes below:

notes.title: Update 0.87
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Once again, with the help from amazing player feedback, we have gathered a list of bugs and glitches that have now been addressed with this update. Please find a list of these fixes below:


     The calendar examine text now shows the correct date as on the calendar itself.
     The item 'light bulb' now gets removed from the game world when it was in characters inventory.
     Fixed an error where using the 'glasses' would stop the cabin area from rendering.
     Bricks now retain correct/saved position upon loading the game.
     Fixed a bug where some switches on the 'switchboard' could not be interacted with.
     Fixed a bug where some laptop buttons would turn black or become invisible when interacting with them.
     Fixed an issue where laptop passwords can now be entered lower and upper case.
     An option has been added to settings, so motion blur can be turned on/off.
     Fixed an bug where the company logo would not display.
     Several spellings and grammar fixes.


Please ensure to close and re-open steam to download the latest version of the game.

As always, if anyone finds any further issues, or has feedback relating to this game, please let us know in the community threads :)

Thanks

Deceptive Games

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS VERSION RELEASED
notes.notes:
Hello and welcome, for today marks an important day. 

Today is the release of "The Initiate 2: The First Interview" into Early Access, and with it, the next stage of initiation.  

Many mysteries (and answers) are held within this game, keep your eyes and ears alert at all times.

All who are wise enough to solve this mystery will be greatly rewarded. 

So take heed, and use your intelligence to solve this mystery - your challenge awaits

But remember: trust no-one but yourself - The games have only just began.

Good luck Initiate!
